in_sanskrit.name: Shahban
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shahban एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Persian word 'shah', meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. The suffix '-ban' is a common Persian suffix used to denote 'master' or 'commander'. This name is often given to a boy who is expected to be a strong and capable leader.
